unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፲፪ — Meraf 12: Grand Master of ፀ and ፈ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ፀ and ፈ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የፀ እና የፈ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: TSEHAY
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'TSEHAY' (Sun) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ፈረስ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Horse' (Feres). Find the correct missing first letter: [ ? ]ረስ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ፈረስ (pronounced Fe-re-s).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 2nd form ➔ 4th form ➔ [ ? ] (6th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ፀሐይ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Sun (Tsehay)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 1st form 'ፀ', breathy 4th form 'ሐ', and end in 6th form 'ይ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: FERES
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'FERES' (Horse) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ፅ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the emphatic native 6th form 'Ts' sound of the ፀ family. Which symbol matches this silent/stopped form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ፊደል
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Alphabet/Letter (Fidel)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 3rd form 'ፊ', followed by 1st form 'ደ', and 6th form 'ል'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: FIDEL
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'FIDEL' (Alphabet) with the correct Amharic word.
